csv_scope_of_work: The University of California, Merced is soliciting Statements of Qualifications from architecture firms interested in providing design & cost estimating services for the following project: Stadium The initial phase of development will prioritize construction of the core athletic field components soccer pitch, track and field event areas, and essential supporting infrastructure while establishing a framework for future phased expansion of spectator seating, athlete support spaces, and associated amenities as program demand and funding evolve. The selected Executive Architect will lead the conceptual design phase, with an emphasis on delivering a flexible, cost-effective design solution that accommodates long-term buildout while maintaining alignment with the established project budget. This phase will include evaluating potential site options, addressing significant site development requirements, developing a comprehensive phasing strategy, and collaborating closely with the project cost estimator to implement a dynamic cost model that enables informed decision-making and ensures the project remains aligned with available funding. Upon receipt of P approval and project funding, the project will advance into full design and implementation phases.
